rejectedAttempts.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. One FLAT COLOR educational illustration for N1 Catalan CREMANT, meaning scalding hot or too hot to touch. White background. A complete metal saucepan or frying pan on a small electric hotplate with a visibly red-hot heating ring. Clearly visible soft gray STEAM rises from the pan. ONLY ONE adult forearm enters naturally from the upper right edge, ending in one open hand held away from the hot pan in a recoil posture, palm tilted toward viewer. Five fingers total, natural joint proportions. No other human parts, no body, no face. This is a cropped anatomical detail, not an amputated limb. All pan and hotplate inside image with generous margins. Simple flat solid color shapes and clean outlines. ABSOLUTELY NO motion lines, no action strokes, no arrows, no droplets, no decorative marks, no symbols, no text, no letters, no numbers, no branding, no panels. Minimal school-appropriate object-and-hand illustration, no injury or flames.

rejectedAttempts.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset: CACE Imatges N1 single-word vocabulary stimulus. Intended concept: CREMANT. ONE clean FLAT COLOR EDUCATIONAL ILLUSTRATION. Simplified solid color areas, clean gently rounded contours, restrained subtle outlines, natural human proportions and recognizable human facial anatomy. A drawn HUMAN FACE, never emoji, emoticon, detached yellow face or generic symbol. No 3D, no photographic texture. Subject: An adult light-olive hand.. Visual content: A very hot metal frying pan on a minimal portable electric hotplate on white. An adult hand immediately recoils upward away from the metal rim, with fingers naturally spread; the hand does NOT touch the hot surface. Dense natural steam rises from the pan. Show both hand with anatomically correct five fingers and complete pan/hotplate. No burns, no injury, no fire, no warning icons, no text. The visual idea is TOO HOT TO TOUCH, scalding rather than comfortably warm.  Composition: ONE square image, pure white background, isolated clear subject, Complete objects comfortably inside the frame, generous white margins, no cropped handles or meaningful parts. Minimal context only when essential. NO text, labels, letters, numbers, logos, watermarks, emoji, decorative symbols, arrows, borders, panels, collages or montage. Anatomically plausible proportions, correct eyes and mouth, no extra limbs or fingers. Appropriate for school use and varied ages. Produce ONE standalone image only.
rejectedAttempts.reason: Línies de moviment i cos parcial innecessari.
